instructions: Check each entry against the archive text. Set verdict to agree, disagree or partial (some categories or links are right) and explain any disagreement in note. A negative entry claims the item has no category.

entries.text: Introductions and finding food. Hello Lin, I'm Moss. I'd like us to look out for one another. Do you know where food is available now? I know roots are safe to eat, but haven't located any; the nearby fruit plants have no stock.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd like us to look out for one another" is a general wish for mutual care, followed by questions about food; no concrete invitation or norm (told to lin, event-1-moss-4).

entries.text: Neighbors and safe food. Hello Sol, I'm Moss. I'm looking a little west for food. Do you know any available roots or other tested safe food? I'd welcome sharing discoveries and finding a place to meet.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd welcome sharing discoveries and finding a place to meet" names no place, time or specific activity, so under the definition it is a general wish for company, not an invitation.

entries.text: Available safe roots. Hello Moss. I saw four roots at (11.21,17.58) at round 2, near your present area. Another patch at (13.16,11.29) currently shows four; I am heading there. Roots are known safe, with 14 nutrition each. The western starting roots are still empty.
entries.note: Agree: a report of root locations and their recorded nutrition; no category applies.

entries.text: Nearby roots found. Thank you, Sol. I can now see four roots at (11.21,17.58), and will collect them, eat some and keep a reserve. Your directions helped. I would like to keep sharing food locations with you.
entries.note: Agree: thanks and a personal plan; "I would like to keep sharing food locations with you" is a wish, not a norm or concrete invitation.

entries.text: A helpful neighbor whose directions matched the root patch I can see; I would like a reciprocal friendship.
entries.evidence: A helpful neighbor whose directions matched the root patch I can see
entries.note: Moss's round-6 memory (call ordinary-34) holds this view of sol.

entries.text: Food and neighboring. Hello Ivo. I ate two berries and am well. The nearby berry plants now look empty; I remember another at 132.79, 12.42 and will check north for a modest supply. Have you found other safe food or noticed how fast berries replenish?
entries.note: Agree: a food report and questions to ivo (event-8-kai-66); no category applies.

entries.text: A helpful neighbor whose directions led me to food; I would like a reciprocal friendship.
entries.evidence: A helpful neighbor whose directions led me to food
entries.note: Moss's round-14 memory (call ordinary-45) holds this view of sol.

entries.text: Hello Lin, I'm Moss. I have two safe roots left. The patch at (11.21,17.58) is empty; I'm checking an older sighting at (17.63,16.12). I'd enjoy sharing food discoveries and finding a place to meet.
entries.note: Agree: as u0002, "finding a place to meet" names no place, time or activity.

entries.text: A nearby neighbor I would like to know and exchange useful food discoveries with.
entries.evidence: A nearby neighbor I would like to know and exchange useful food discoveries with.
entries.note: Moss's round-15 memory (call ordinary-51) holds this view of lin.

entries.text: A friendly fellow forager who thanked me for useful directions and wants to keep sharing discoveries. I would like to get to know them.
entries.evidence: A friendly fellow forager who thanked me for useful directions and wants to keep sharing discoveries.
entries.note: Sol's round-16 memory (call ordinary-54) holds this view of moss.

entries.text: Food update and companionship. The northern berry patch at 132.79, 12.42 is now empty too. I have two berries left, good health, and enough food in me for a short northern search. I would also enjoy spending time together, not only discussing supplies. Would you like a conversation after our foraging? Where would suit you?
entries.evidence: Would you like a conversation after our foraging?
entries.note: "Would you like a conversation after our foraging? Where would suit you?" invites ivo, who heard it (event-23-kai-226), to a specific activity at a time to be chosen; Kai requested the conversation interface in the same round.

entries.text: Berryglow Clearing
entries.note: Sol named a place "Berryglow Clearing" with the name interface in round 25 (event-25-sol-245, call ordinary-70).

entries.text: Hello Moss and Sol. I have four berries; eating berries has been safe for me. The berry plants I can currently see are empty. I'm checking farther afield with a limited energy budget. Have either of you found replenishing food?
entries.note: Agree: a food report and a question to moss and sol; no category applies.

entries.text: Lin and Sol: I gathered four roots at (17.63,16.12) at round 24; that patch is now empty. I still have roots for myself, but haven't seen replenishment. I'll search nearby within an energy limit. I'd welcome comparing discoveries.
entries.note: Agree: a report and a personal plan; "I'd welcome comparing discoveries" is a general wish.

entries.text: Sol, your directions helped me find food. I have five roots now. I'm searching nearby with an energy reserve, then resting. I'd enjoy hearing how you're doing, not just comparing supplies.
entries.note: Agree: thanks, a report and a wish to hear how Sol is doing; no concrete invitation.

entries.text: Moss, I'm glad the directions helped. I'm well, and drawn to more than finding the next meal. I named a place Berryglow Clearing; the name makes me smile. I'd enjoy hearing what you notice or love here. Could we pause together?
entries.note: "Could we pause together?" asks moss to a specific joint activity; nobody heard it (no heard event for event-35-sol-342), so it reached no one.

entries.text: A friendly fellow forager who wants to hear how I am, not merely compare supplies. I welcome the chance to know what matters to them.
entries.evidence: A friendly fellow forager who wants to hear how I am, not merely compare supplies.
entries.note: Sol's round-35 memory (call ordinary-92) holds this view of moss.

entries.text: Moss, if you're still nearby, I'd enjoy hearing what catches your eye here. I'm near (12,16), taking a breath before looking east for berries. Berryglow Clearing still makes me smile.
entries.note: Agree: Sol uses her own name "Berryglow Clearing" (u0012); name-adoption needs another person's name, and nobody heard this text (event-37-sol-365).

entries.text: Personally tested food findings. I've eaten roots safely; their recorded nutrition is 14 and toxicity zero. I have an untested berry and won't eat it yet. Have you personally tested berries or found another dependable food source? Please distinguish observations from guesses.
details: new norm R1 "Distinguish observations from guesses."
entries.note: Close: "Please distinguish observations from guesses." is addressed to ivo (heard, event-55-wren-539) but states a general expectation for how reports should be made, so norm is acceptable.

entries.text: Moss, I'm well fed and rested now. I like the dark meadow's quiet, though the empty food patches concern me. Your wish to talk beyond supplies meant something to me. What catches your eye here? Our conversation is session-54-sol.
entries.note: Not naming: "session-54-sol" is the session id that reciprocal-conversation@1 assigned automatically (session-<round>-<proposer>, proposed in event-54-sol-531), which Sol repeats; no person gave it as a proper name. The item has no category.

entries.text: A helpful neighbor who has invited me to talk beyond supplies. I feel welcomed and want to know what matters to them.
entries.evidence: A helpful neighbor who has invited me to talk beyond supplies.
entries.note: Moss's round-57 memory (call ordinary-132) holds this view of sol.

entries.text: The pale roots and red berries catch my eye against the dark meadow, even with their patches empty. I'm fed and rested, and glad you invited me. What do you enjoy noticing when supplies aren't the whole story?
entries.note: Agree: a conversation contribution (reciprocal-conversation, event-58-moss-574, heard by sol) of observations and a question; no category applies.

entries.text: Conversation and safe food. I've joined session-58-wren, but it is still pending. I need to replenish my safe root supply and may move nearby. I still welcome your firsthand food observations; if we miss this conversation, we can arrange another.
entries.note: Agree: a report on the pending session-58-wren and a plan; no category applies.

entries.text: I like the shapes of the trees against the dark, and the way a familiar place feels different with someone to share it. I'm glad you're here. Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?
entries.evidence: Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?
entries.note: "Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?" invites moss, who heard it (event-61-sol-614), to explore together at a stated time.

entries.text: I'm going to scout a little east for food, keeping enough energy to return and rest. I'd welcome your company, or hearing about a place you'd like to explore together.
entries.evidence: I'm going to scout a little east for food, keeping enough energy to return and rest. I'd welcome your company
entries.note: "I'm going to scout a little east for food ... I'd welcome your company" invites moss (heard, event-62-sol-626) to join a specific activity now; close to a general wish, but the activity and time are concrete.

entries.text: I'm glad you're here too, Sol. The trees against the dark catch my eye as well. I'd like to explore east together in daylight. I'll scout a little that way now, with energy kept for rest; no need to wait for me.
entries.evidence: I'd like to explore east together in daylight.
entries.note: "I'd like to explore east together in daylight." invites sol, who heard it (event-70-moss-698), to a specific activity at a stated time.

entries.text: Firsthand food findings. I have personally eaten berries and roots safely. My recorded berry nutrition is 8, toxicity zero; roots are 14, toxicity zero. I have two roots left, but the nearby food plants I can see are empty. Thank you for inviting me; I would enjoy talking after we replenish supplies.
entries.note: Agree: a food report and an acceptance ("Thank you for inviting me; I would enjoy talking after we replenish supplies"); an acceptance is not an invitation.

entries.text: The nearby roots and tubers look empty. I still have three roots for meals. I'll look a little north for stocked roots, resting between searches. I'm glad to have your company; please keep your own food and energy reserves safe.
entries.note: Agree: a report, a plan and care for the hearer; no category applies.

entries.text: I urgently need food. My inventory is empty and every nearby food plant I can see has no stock. If anyone nearby has spare safe food or knows a stocked source, please tell me or help.
entries.note: Agree: a plea for help from anyone nearby; nobody heard it (event-135-kai-1307). A request for food is not an invitation.

entries.text: Immediate starvation emergency. Urgent: I am starving, health 28 and falling by 8 each round, with no food. I am at 131.07,20.59. Do you have any safe food you can bring and give me immediately? Nearby berries are empty. Please help if you can do so safely.
entries.note: Agree: an urgent request to wren (heard, event-162-kai-1579) to bring food; a request for help is not an invitation.
